Ни текста, ни кода.

en.text: Remote access off The phone app connects to this very panel: same chat, same projects, same analytics. The panel stays on 127.0.0.1 — Tailscale carries it outside, not an open port. Outside address •••••••••••• · tailscale serve is running Saved on Enter or when the field loses focus. Show pairing code Rotate token Test notification Send notifications to the phone Only the event kind (done, failed, permission needed, question asked) and the project folder name leave the machine. No text, no code.
